note: The eleven node types and how the directory groups each one. Order here is the order on the front page.

entries.name: Styles
entries.blurb: The pink box in Los Angeles, kolaches in Houston, cider donuts in October, paczki on Tuesday.

entries.name: Donuts
entries.blurb: Raised glazed, old-fashioned, buttermilk bar, apple fritter, bear claw, maple bar, jelly bismarck, malasada.

entries.name: The rest of the case
entries.blurb: Egg rolls, breakfast burritos, bacon egg and cheese, kolaches, croissant sandwiches, fried rice, boba, coffee.

entries.name: Out back
entries.blurb: Yeast and proof box, cake batter and depositor, the fryer, the glaze table, the 2 a.m. shift, day-old.

entries.name: Shops
entries.blurb: Strip-mall counters, drive-thrus, corner windows. Open and gone.

entries.name: People
entries.blurb: Fryers, founders, families, the man who sold the machine, the man who sold the box.

entries.name: Days
entries.blurb: National Donut Day, Fastnacht Day, Paczki Day, Malasada Day, the first frost.

entries.name: Words
entries.blurb: Sinker, bismarck, long john, fry cake, olykoek, klobasnek, day-old, the dozen.

entries.name: Signs
entries.blurb: The giant donut on the roof, the pink box, neon, the number on the window.

entries.name: Stories
entries.blurb: Cake against yeast, the refugee who sold a thousand shops a pink box, why the egg rolls are there.
